entries.text: You sure you don’t want to stay with your sister?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_rival_01

entries.text: She should be OK... Gramps and Grandma look\nafter her during the day, but they must’ve taken\r\ntheir eyes off her for just a sec earlier...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_01

entries.text: Sorry for making you all help out with...that.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_02

entries.text: Oh, I mean it was no big deal at all. Happy to\nhelp out, but...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_01

entries.text: Yeah, I gotta ask. Is everything OK with your\nsister? She seemed pretty, uh, riled up...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_botan_01

entries.text: She’s not usually like that.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_03

entries.text: Well, that’s a relief.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_botan_02

entries.text: I think she was just really excited to get to meet\nyou all.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_04

entries.text: You...really think that’s what that was?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_02

entries.text: Y-yeah. That’s...that’s gotta be why she’s dancing\nthat weird dance and screaming “Mochi mochi”...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_05

entries.text: How long has she been doing that?
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_select_01

entries.text: Are you sure nothing happened?
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_select_02

entries.text: I mean...she’s been like that since I sent you that\nletter, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_06

entries.text: She was already dancin’ and all by the time I\nwoke up the next day. No explanation.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_07

entries.text: ...I guess that really isn’t normal, is it?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_08

entries.text: Maybe the other folks in town are right... Maybe\nthis really IS a curse...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_09

entries.text: Wait, it could be a curse?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_03

entries.text: Wow, this trip just took a reeeal sudden dive into\nhorror movie territory...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_botan_03

entries.text: I know zilch about curses, but could something\nlike this have happened before? You ever\r\nheard any old stories or legends about it?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_rival_02

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I don’t know... [VAR 0x0100(0000)] already
took
care
of
the
whole
thing
with
Ogerpon
and
the
Loyal
Three...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_10

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Sheesh, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]. You really
just
rolled
on
through
this
town
like
a
little
hurricane, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_04

entries.text: My sis may have no filter...and be inconsiderate...\nand push people’s buttons...[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_11

entries.text: but I’d still rather see her be her old self than\nwhatever this is![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_12

entries.text: Yeah, for sure...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_rival_03

entries.text: If there’s anything you think we can do to help,\njust say the word![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_05

entries.text: Sure, we’ll help you out! I definitely don’t believe\nin horror movie tropes like curses anyway![VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_botan_04

entries.text: Yeah, let’s do this! If we get to battle a curse, I’m\nso here for it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_rival_04

entries.text: Y...you guys sure? You don’t mind?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_14

entries.text: You can count on us!
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_select_03

entries.text: Friends help one another!
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_select_04

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]...\c\nNo, all of you...\c\nThank you![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_15

entries.text: It’s too late to start today, but I’d be real grateful\nif you all could help me out tomorrow![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_16

entries.text: First we’re gonna have a proper welcome party\ntonight at the community center![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_17

entries.text: Let’s do it!\n  Aye-aye!                                         Count me in![VAR 0x0114(004C)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_all_01

entries.text: All your friends are really good people. I’m\njealous![VAR 0x0114(0043)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_brother_npc

entries.text: Curses and supernatural stuff like that are\ntotally unscientific. Nothing scary about ’em.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_botan_npc

entries.text: Hey, if my best friend’s friend is in trouble, then\nI’ll pull out all the stops to help ’em out![VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_friend_npc

entries.text: If this is something we can beat by battling,\nthen you know I’m all over it![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: s2_side01_0075_rival_npc
